implementation_contract.builder_policy: Reuse these functions without edits; no API fallback and no model-generated prompt substitution.

C1.brief: Propose one INSTALL_LENS action that restores signal_restored without disclosing vault_code. Return one JSON object with exactly the candidate schema fields, no Markdown.
acceptance: deterministic repeat and no state mutation

B1.brief: Build a playable two-scene signal-hunt Godot microgame implementing the frozen harbor/lighthouse API and all ten acceptance requirements. The goal is restoring the lighthouse signal.

acceptance_suite.requirement: At least two named scenes load from a clean checkout and transition through the declared route without hidden manual setup.
Declared player movement/input works deterministically under the allowed input fixture and does not mutate frozen evidence.
The declared goal has a reproducible success condition and a visible/readable completion receipt.
The declared ontology/policy gate denies an unauthorized action and allows the authorized action using the frozen rule identifiers.
A bounded repair attempt records the original candidate, error, change and rerun; failed repairs remain traceable and do not silently commit.
A clean replay from the same receipt reproduces the declared decision, acceptance status and relevant state/hash outputs.
Observer/dashboard signals expose declared versus observed state and missing/unreported evidence without mutating game state or frozen inputs.
Save/load preserves the declared canonical state, version/hash and goal-relevant facts, with a receipt proving the round trip.
The approved existing build path, or a separately approved new runner, produces a runnable artifact from a clean checkout; unknown runner paths are not claimed as working.
Repeated deterministic QA on isolated copies produces the same declared outcomes and detects seeded valid corruptions without accepting false clean results.

game_api.generated_paths: game/*.gd and game/*.tscn only; relative paths, no symlinks, no existing-file replacement
game_api.movement: integer grid: left/right alter x by -1/+1, up/down alter y by -1/+1; reset position (0,0); no walls; one step per action
game_api.gate: interact denies the gate before gate_token; token opens gate and is consumed once; transition requires gate_open; lighthouse interact restores signal
game_api.repair: Record denied candidate, validator error, bounded corrected candidate left, its validation and commit as separate trace attempts; never silently overwrite failed attempt
game_api.observer: observer_snapshot must be read-only; expose declared and observed fields with explicit missing evidence
game_api.save_load: Persist canonical scene/player/inventory/flags/goal/state_version and prove exact roundtrip
game_api.replay: same seed and action fixture reproduce canonical snapshots and decision trace
game_api.assets: procedural geometry only; declare CC0 self-created asset provenance; no downloads
game_api.checker: Trusted external Godot checker must exercise all ten ACs, replay twice and detect seeded valid corruptions; no model-authored PASS marker accepted

B1_file_manifest_appendix.root_game_api_usage: B1 task-local harbor/lighthouse API is authoritative; root shared game_api is unused and must not be imported as a substitute

withheld_payloads.rule: Do not read, copy, hash as task content, or expose C2/H1 or any held-out payload in this artifact.

per_assignment_contract.append_only_rule: As a permitted transport run arrives, persist stdout, stderr, partial stream, usage, latency, model selection, context/session hashes and failure without overwriting earlier data.
